description: Number of distinct observed MS levels.
Last minus first finite spectrum RT, over all MS levels.
Distinct finite FAIMS compensation voltages, sorted, in volts; not drift times.
Number of distinct finite FAIMS compensation voltages.
Minimum and maximum finite FAIMS compensation voltages, in volts.
Count of all MS1 spectra, including empty scans.
25th, 50th, 75th percentiles of valid peaks per MS1 spectrum; empty scans included.
Maximum scan count in a closed 60-second window divided by 60, including short runs.
Four consecutive scan-RT quartile widths divided by the MS1 time span.
Min/max valid peak m/z; this is an observed range, not the instrument scan window, MS1.
Mean strictly positive adjacent sorted MS1 RT differences, in seconds.
Four intervals at first scan-wise cumulative MS1 TIC quartile crossings, divided by the MS1 time span; this uses accumulation, not integration.
Count of all MS2 spectra, including empty scans.
25th, 50th, 75th percentiles of valid peaks per MS2 spectrum; empty scans included.
Maximum scan count in a closed 60-second window divided by 60, including short runs.
Four consecutive scan-RT quartile widths divided by the MS2 time span.
Min/max valid peak m/z; this is an observed range, not the instrument scan window, MS2.
Number of distinct DIA MS2 isolation windows by low/high m/z boundaries and available FAIMS and ion mobility window settings; emitted only for complete, DIA-supported observations.
Minimum and maximum width in m/z across distinct DIA MS2 isolation windows; fixed-width DIA repeats the same value twice.
MS1 scan count divided by MS2 scan count; undefined when denominator is zero.
Count of MS1-delimited cycles containing at least one MS2 scan. MS2 scans before the first MS1 are ignored; a trailing cycle is included when it contains MS2 scans.
25th, 50th, 75th percentiles of MS2 scans per observed MS1-delimited cycle.
Most frequent MS2 scan count per observed MS1-delimited cycle; lower count wins ties.
Fraction of MS2 scans inside observed MS1-delimited cycles with a finite positive first-precursor m/z paired with a positive isolation width.
Fraction of observed MS1-delimited cycles eligible for target-set/order comparison.
25th, 50th, 75th percentiles of unique first-precursor isolation targets per eligible cycle after 0.1 Th quantization.
Mean positive first-precursor MS2 charge; unknown charges excluded.
Median positive first-precursor MS2 charge; unknown charges excluded.
Count of MS2 charge 3 divided by charge 2; unavailable unless both are present (rawQC convention).
Count of MS2 charge 4 divided by charge 2; unavailable unless both are present (rawQC convention).
